news.title: Athena Global Technologies Limited announced that it has received INR 14.7 million in funding
news.body: On April 13, 2026, Athena Global Technologies Limited closed the transaction. The company issued 700,000 convertible warrants at an issue price of INR 21 for gross proceeds of INR 14,700,000. The transaction includes participation from individual investor, Karthikeya Manchala. The warrant exercise price will be of INR 63. The transaction has been approved by board of director.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.1% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
